item.title: Thyself - Full Stack Developer
item.description: Worked on a startup project in a group of 15 people over 3 month period and resulted in over 1,000 users. Designed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based Article Recommendation System with pre-trained LLMs. Developed backend service using PostgreSQL and a FastAPI.

item.title: MSc Student - University of Guelph
item.description:
Apply and assess standard ML pipelines including random forests, SVM, classic NN on proteomics and metabolomics of urines to pre-dict litter size and fertility status of pigs. Optimize feed fermentation process by analyzing high dimensional time-series data on temperature, moisture content, and pH level to reduce anti-nutritional factors.

Overview

During my Master’s program at the University of Guelph, I applied machine learning techniques to analyze high-dimensional biological data for predictive modeling and process optimization.

item.title: Backend Developer - Animal Health Laboratory
item.description:
